title: The Monthly Cycle of a Personal Services Plan — Fees, Hours, Rollover and Expiry
content:
The personal services statement and the hours balance of a Personal Services Plan follow one monthly cycle.

## The cycle

1. **First day of an active month.** The tier's monthly package fee is charged in advance and the tier's monthly hours allotment is granted. Nothing is charged or granted for a suspended month, or for the Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan.
2. **End of each month.** The hours remaining on the plan at the end of the month's last day expire as one month-end expiry.
3. **Rollover.** Where the tier's rollover period is 1 month, the lesser of those unused hours and the tier's rollover cap is granted back on the first day of the next month as rollover hours. Rollover hours that remain unused at the end of that next month expire with the rest and never roll a second time.
4. **End of the plan.** When the plan ends, all remaining hours expire as one plan-end expiry on the end date. No hours are ever paid out in money.
5. **Residency ending mid-month.** Where the tier prorates the package fee on the end of a residency and the plan ends mid-month because the residency ended, the package fee for the days after the end date is returned as a residency-end proration credit. The daily fee is the monthly fee divided by the number of days in that month, rounded to the cent half up, and the credit is that daily fee for each day after the end date.

## What may be posted in each plan status

Package fees and hour grants may be posted only while the plan is active or cancellation pending; expiries may also be posted once the plan has ended.

| Plan status on record | Package fee, hour grant, rollover grant | Expiry |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | Yes |
| Cancellation pending | Yes | Yes |
| Ended | No | Yes |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

- **Rollover.** A plan whose tier rolls hours over with a cap of 10 hours ends a month with 6.5 unused hours. All 6.5 hours expire at month end and 6.5 hours (the lesser of 6.5 and 10) are granted back on the first of the next month as rollover hours. If 2 of them are still unused at the end of that next month, they expire with the rest of that month's hours and are not rolled again.
- **Proration.** A plan with a hypothetical monthly fee of 519.00 USD ends with the residency on the 21st of a 31-day month. The daily fee is 519.00 divided by 31, or 16.741935..., rounded half up to 16.74 USD; the 10 days after the end date give a residency-end proration credit of 167.40 USD.
- **No rollover tier.** On a tier whose rollover period is 0 months, the month-end expiry is not followed by any rollover grant.
